name: acf/product-category-grid
title: Product Category Grid
description: Displays product_category taxonomy terms as rectangular flip cards — front shows category image, back shows category description. Pulls automatically from the product_category taxonomy. Scott Pete override: routes card links through ipc_get_category_card_url() instead of a plain term link, and renders the PREMIUM PRODUCTS-style header from the same products_grid_title/products_grid_subtitle options used on the category and single-product templates.
